Hi, I’m Monica Mozingo — a Licensed Massage Therapist, yoga guide, and wellness creator sharing a slower approach to everyday life 🌿

This channel is where wellness meets real life — from yoga and movement to massage therapy, motherhood, natural living, nature, and the little rituals that help us feel more at home in our bodies.

As I step into motherhood, this space will naturally grow with me. You’ll find:

• Yoga & mindful movement
• Motherhood + family-centered wellness
• Massage therapy & self-care
• Natural hair & simple beauty routines
• Nature, outdoor wellness & slow living
• Day-in-the-life as a massage therapist & yoga guide

Wellness doesn't have to be perfect — it can simply be a way of coming back to yourself, one season at a time.

Come stretch, breathe, move, mother, rest, and grow with me. 🌿🤎


➡️ @wellnesswithmonicasheri (Instagram)
📍 Based in North Carolina
